sections.Profile:
"Card Castle" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Nordamatic in 1977. Designed for single-player gameplay, it features an "add-a-ball" mechanism, allowing players to earn additional balls during play.

- Manufacturer: Nordamatic
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy
